info.longBusinessSummary: Marvell Technology, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides data infrastructure semiconductor solutions and spanning the data center core to network edge in the United States, Argentina, China, India, Israel, Japan, Singapore, South Korea, Taiwan, Vietnam, and internationally. The company develops and scales system-on-a-chip architectures, integrating analog, mixed-signal, and digital signal processing functionality. It offers a portfolio of ethernet solutions, including spanning controllers, network adapters, physical transceivers, and switches; single or multiple core processors; and custom application specific integrated circuits, interconnects, fibre channel adapters, and processors. The company also provides interconnect products, including pulse amplitude modulation, coherent and coherent-lite digital signal processors (DSPs), laser drivers, trans-impedance amplifiers, silicon photonics, co-packaged optics, linear pluggable optics chipsets, data center interconnect, active electrical cable DSPs and peripheral component interconnect express retimer solutions; fibre channel products comprising host bus adapters and controllers for server and storage system connectivity; storage controllers for hard disk drives and solid-state-drives; host system interfaces, including serial advanced technology attachment and serial attached SCSI, peripheral component interconnect express, compute express link switches, non-volatile memory express (NVMe), and NVMe over fabrics; and develops ultra accelerator linkTM switches and ethernet for scale-up networking switches. The company serves data centers, communications, and other markets. It offers its products through direct customers and distributors. Marvell Technology, Inc. was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware.

MARVELL AND LUMENTUM TO COMBINE, CREATING A CATEGORY LEADER IN AI CONNECTIVITY

|
• |
|
Combines two of the fastest-growing enablers of AI, bringing together complementary electrical and optical
technologies to address increasingly complex connectivity requirements across next-generation AI infrastructure
|

|
• |
|
Expected to create a broad full-stack connectivity portfolio that is intended to enable end-to-end extreme co-design, high-volume production of fully-optimized, pre-validated optical
solutions and faster time to market for customers
|

|
• |
|
Expected to expand the combined company’s total addressable market to
$550 billion
|

|
• |
|
The transaction is expected to enhance the combined company’s long-term revenue growth, non-GAAP gross margin and non-GAAP operating margin profile, provide line of sight to more than $1 billion in annual
run-rate cost synergies, and is expected to be accretive to Marvell non-GAAP earnings per share in year one post-close
|

SANTA CLARA, Calif. and SAN JOSE, Calif. – November 2, 2026 – Marvell Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ: MRVL) and Lumentum
(NASDAQ: LITE) today announced that they have entered into a definitive agreement for Marvell to acquire Lumentum in an all-stock transaction. Under the terms of the agreement, Lumentum stockholders will
receive a fixed exchange ratio of 4.500 shares of Marvell common stock for each share of Lumentum common stock they own. The transaction has an implied enterprise value of $115 billion for Lumentum, representing approximately $1,132 per share
of Lumentum common stock and a premium of approximately 23.9% based on each company’s unaffected closing share price as of October 28, 2026, the last trading day before market speculation regarding a potential transaction began.
Post-closing, current Marvell stockholders will own approximately 67% of the combined company on a fully diluted basis, while Lumentum stockholders will own approximately 33%.

The AI infrastructure industry is at an inflection point. Rapidly growing bandwidth requirements and the physical limitations of copper-based connectivity are
accelerating the transition toward optical technologies. As AI infrastructure scales to increasingly complex architectures, particularly scale-up and scale-in, the
industry is shifting from discrete, modular components toward highly integrated optical solutions that require much closer co-design of electrical and optical technologies to deliver greater bandwidth,
performance and energy efficiency.
The combination brings together
best-in-breed technology to meet this need, joining Marvell’s strengths in electrical and optical interconnect, network switching, custom XPU and XPU attach, and
advanced semiconductor technologies with Lumentum’s expertise in high-performance lasers, optical transceivers, optical circuit switching (OCS) and specialized compound semiconductor manufacturing. Following closing, the combined company is
expected to offer a highly complementary portfolio spanning leading-edge CMOS, silicon photonics, compound semiconductors, advanced packaging and manufacturing capabilities. The combination is intended to enable deeper integration and co-design across the electrical and optical signal chain, positioning Marvell to deliver highly optimized connectivity solutions across a wide range of distances, from distributed data centers to connections within
advanced semiconductor packages.
“AI infrastructure is undergoing a fundamental architectural shift toward optical connectivity, creating an
opportunity that comes along once in a generation,” said Matt Murphy, Chairman and CEO of Marvell. “The companies that move first and help define this transition will set the standard for decades to come. By bringing together two leaders
with highly complementary technologies, exceptional talent and specialized manufacturing capabilities, we intend to help shape the next era of AI connectivity and create exceptional stockholder value.”

“Joining Marvell creates a company uniquely positioned to capitalize on a market opportunity of $550 billion and generate significant, sustainable
stockholder value,” said Michael Hurlston, President and CEO of Lumentum. “Surging AI data traffic requires rapid hardware innovation, and this combination enhances our ability to deliver next-generation solutions at scale. Together with
Marvell, we will meet our customers’ complete interconnect needs, spanning scale-across and scale-out today to scale-up and
scale-in domains tomorrow. By offering extreme co-design around our customers’ demanding requirements, we will help them achieve faster time to market, accelerated
innovation cycles, and category-defining performance.”

Compelling Strategic and Financial Rationale

The combination is expected to deliver substantial strategic and financial benefits:

|
• |
|
Creates a category leader in AI connectivity: Combining Marvell’s electrical and optical
interconnect, switching and custom silicon technologies with Lumentum’s high-performance lasers, optical transceivers and OCS capabilities will create a comprehensive connectivity portfolio spanning scale-across,
scale-out, scale-up and scale-in. Upon closing, the combined company anticipates being positioned to address customer
connectivity requirements across a broad range of distances and topologies, from distributed data centers to advanced semiconductor packages.
|

|
• |
|
Enables end-to-end extreme co-design and accelerates customer innovation: As AI infrastructure becomes increasingly complex, customers require higher levels of integration and optimization across digital, analog and optical technologies.
By bringing together complementary technologies and engineering expertise across the signal chain, the combined company expects to be positioned to develop highly-optimized, pre-validated optical solutions
designed to improve bandwidth, performance and power efficiency, accelerate customer time to market and support high-volume production.
|

|
• |
|
Combines highly specialized manufacturing capabilities and enhances R&D resources: Lumentum brings
advanced compound semiconductor manufacturing and process technologies, including indium phosphide (InP), as well as high-speed and high-power laser capabilities. After closing, the combined company plans to bring together leading-edge semiconductor
design, advanced packaging and specialized manufacturing capabilities to enable deeper heterogeneous integration, strengthen strategic supply and accelerate the development of next-generation optical technologies.
|

|
• |
|
Creates significant long-term stockholder value: The combination brings together two of the
fastest-growing companies enabling AI infrastructure and expands the combined company’s total addressable market to $550 billion and enhances the combined company’s ability to serve customers in emerging scale-up and scale-in markets. The transaction is expected to enhance the combined company’s long-term revenue growth, non-GAAP
gross margin and non-GAAP operating margin profile, provide line of sight to more than $1 billion in annual run-rate cost synergies, and is expected to be accretive
to Marvell non-GAAP earnings per share in year one post-close.
|
Transaction Structure and
Terms
Under the terms of the agreement, which has been unanimously approved by the boards of directors of both companies, Lumentum stockholders will
receive a fixed exchange ratio of 4.500 shares of Marvell common stock for each share of Lumentum common stock held at the time of closing, implying pro forma ownership of approximately 33% of the combined company for Lumentum stockholders on a
fully diluted basis.
Following closing, Matt Murphy will continue as Chairman and CEO of the combined company. As part of the transaction, three members
of Lumentum’s Board of Directors, including Lumentum CEO Michael Hurlston, will join Marvell’s Board, which currently consists of seven directors.

The transaction is expected to close in the first half of calendar year 2028, subject to approval by Marvell and Lumentum stockholders, receipt of regulatory
approvals and other customary closing conditions.

Marvell Reports Preliminary Revenue for the Fiscal Third Quarter 2027 and Lumentum Issues Fiscal First
Quarter 2027 Results
In connection with today’s announcement, Marvell today reported preliminary revenue for the third quarter of fiscal 2027
consistent with previously provided guidance, maintaining the midpoint of its prior guidance while narrowing the expected range to plus or minus 2%, compared with the original range of plus or minus 5%.

Lumentum today separately reported financial results for its first fiscal quarter of 2027. Lumentum’s financial results can be found on the Investors
section of the Lumentum website at http://investor.Lumentum.com .
Conference Call Information

Marvell and Lumentum will host a joint conference call today at 5:00 a.m. Pacific Time (8:00 a.m. Eastern Time) to discuss the transaction. To participate,
dial 800-579-2543 (U.S.) or 785-424-1789 (international) and reference conference ID
5554083. The call will be webcast on Marvell’s Investor Relations website , where an accompanying investor presentation will also be posted shortly.

Advisors
Qatalyst Partners is serving as lead financial
advisor and J.P. Morgan Securities LLC and Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC are serving as financial advisors to Marvell. Wilson Sonsini Goodrich & Rosati is serving as legal advisor to Marvell, and FGS Global is serving as strategic
communications advisor. Citigroup Global Markets Inc. and Evercore are serving as financial advisors to Lumentum, Davis Polk & Wardwell LLP is serving as legal advisor, and Joele Frank, Wilkinson Brimmer Katcher is serving as strategic
communications advisor.
About Marvell
To deliver
the data infrastructure technology that connects the world, we’re building solutions on the most powerful foundation: our partnerships with our customers. Trusted by the world’s leading technology companies for over 30 years, we move,
store, process and secure the world’s data with semiconductor solutions designed for our customers’ current needs and future ambitions. Through a process of deep collaboration and transparency, we’re ultimately changing the way
tomorrow’s enterprise, cloud and carrier architectures transform—for the better.
About Lumentum

Lumentum is a global leader in optical and photonic technologies that power the networks and infrastructure behind AI, cloud computing, and next-generation
communications. Built on decades of photonics innovation, Lumentum delivers high-performance lasers, modules, and optical subsystems that enable scalable, energy-efficient data center connectivity, advanced telecom networks, industrial
manufacturing, and sensing applications. Headquartered in San Jose, California, the company operates R&D, manufacturing, and sales facilities worldwide. Learn more at www.lumentum.com.

Additional Information About the Transaction and Where to Find It

This communication relates to a proposed transaction between Marvell Technology, Inc. (“Marvell”) and Lumentum Holdings Inc.
(“Lumentum”) (the “Transaction”). In connection with the Transaction, Marvell intends to file with the SEC a registration statement on Form S-4 (the “Form S-4”) that will include a joint proxy statement for Marvell’s and Lumentum’s respective stockholders and that will also constitute a prospectus with respect to the shares of Marvell’s common
stock to be issued in the Transaction (the “Joint Proxy Statement/Prospectus”). The definitive Joint Proxy Statement/Prospectus (if and when available) will be mailed to stockholders of Marvell and Lumentum after the Form S-4 is declared effective

by the SEC. This communication is not a substitute for the Joint Proxy Statement/Prospectus or registration statement. MARVELL, LUMENTUM, THE TRANSACTION AND RELATED MATTERS. Investors and security holders will be able to obtain free copies of the Form S-4 and Joint Proxy Statement/Prospectus and other documents containing

available online free of charge on Lumentum’s website at https://investor.lumentum.com or by contacting Lumentum’s Investor Relations department at investor.relations@lumentum.com .
